name: rotate-everything
description: Rotate any block by a free angle from the editor sidebar. Server-rendered CSS transform, no JavaScript on the front end.

scripts.i18n: wp i18n make-pot . languages/rotate-everything.pot --slug=rotate-everything --domain=rotate-everything --package-name="Rotate Everything" --exclude=vendor,node_modules,build,dist,docs,tests,.github && wp i18n update-po languages/rotate-everything.pot languages/rotate-everything-fr_FR.po && wp i18n make-mo languages/ && wp i18n make-json languages/ --no-purge --pretty-print --use-map='{"src/editor.js":"build/editor.js"}'
